newsitem.title: FINLAND: Clinton hears thumps in the night, accuses Yeltsin.
newsitem.headline: Clinton hears thumps in the night, accuses Yeltsin.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton began his meeting with Boris Yeltsin on Friday by complaining of loud banging on his hotel room ceiling during the night and joking accused the Russian president of sabotaging his sleep.
"Boris, I thought you had hired an extra-large Finn to stomp on my roof," White House spokesman Mike McCurry quoted Clinton as telling Yeltsin.
The two were making small talk as they waited for photographers and journalists at a photo opportunity at the start of their summit.

The spokesman said Clinton told Yeltsin that he had not had "the most restful evening" because of a series of thumps on his ceiling after midnight, adding that the apparent explanation was the clanging of pipes from the hotel sauna above his room.
Clinton is staying in the central Helsinki Inter-Continental hotel.

Despite an injured knee that has kept him in a wheelchair, Clinton flew to Helsinki to attend the summit, which was itself moved from Washington to Finland to make matters easier for Yeltsin, who is recovering from heart surgery and pneumonia.
